central_idea_and_construction: An original affectionate cat mascot centered above exactly MISO. A broad gently pear-shaped face, small rounded triangular ears, one sleepy half-closed eye and one simple upright oval eye, tiny curved mouth; distinctive asymmetry comes from a soft cheek rising on one side. The face is an apricot filled silhouette, eye and mouth marks in deep plum, no whiskers or fine fur. Underneath, MISO in custom plump but open rounded uppercase letters; the M shoulders and O share the cheek curvature. Keep the eyes simple and calm rather than cartoon-excited. Cat and name have a generous clear gap. Entire lockup centered at 57% width and 68% height. No props, paws, ribbons, badges or famous mascot resemblance.
color_roles: dark plum lettering and facial details
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Tilted cheek, sleepy expression and readable MISO.
specific_risk: Eyes may lose asymmetry at tiny display sizes; intended brand use is larger than app-icon scale.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
structural_difference: friendly compact cat and soft wordmark
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
